dedupe_keys.name: ancillary data for the wrf to tell processing chain

description: The IM3 project publishes ancillary data for the `wrf_to_tell` processing chain, which turns Weather Research and Forecasting model meteorology into inputs for the Total Electricity Loads model. Zenodo lists one public ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The deposit links to the `im3components` repository, where the processing code sits in the `wrf_to_tell` module; the repository describes Python and R components for coupling IM3 models under BSD-2-Clause. These ancillary inputs may be needed to reproduce or adapt county-to-balancing-authority weather conversion for electricity-demand simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the ancillary package. A limitation is that Zenodo does not list the ZIP’s internal files, years, region keys or variable units. It does not itself contain the main WRF climate outputs or a runnable TELL model. The code repository was inspected at the README level, but this archive was not downloaded and the processing chain was not executed.
